name: tts-s22
description: On-device text-to-speech for the S22: s22-say neural engines (supertonic default, paradee, kitten, piper, kokoro, Greek Piper el-antonis/el-female, espeak) rendered through s22-touchd and, by default, spoken through the phone speaker (firmware-graph audio path; the amps return to the resting mute afterwards). Set play=false to render only.
